name: dyy_photo_deconstruct
desc_en: Turn a user's photo into a vertical, textless "ink-wash silhouette deconstruction" zine poster on aged paper. Each subject is reduced to its essential silhouette or a single gesture line, with only the minimum necessary interior marks (a few color blocks, dots, or thin strokes) to keep the scene readable.
